item.title: HITMAN World of Assassination Elusive Target mission ‘Eminem vs. Slim Shady’ launches December 1
item.description: IO Interactive has announced HITMAN World of Assassination limited-time Elusive Target mission “Eminem vs. Slim Shady,” which will be available for free from December 1 to 31.

item.title: Street Fighter 6 sales top six million
item.description: Total sales for Street Fighter 6 have surpassed six million units worldwide, Capcom announced.

item.title: Winning Post 10 2026 announced for PS5, Switch 2, PS4, Switch, and PC
